# SOP-P2-L2-05 Planned shutdown - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-IH01, EQ-P2-L2-HT02, EQ-P2-L2-RR03

Purpose
1. Provide controlled sequence for planned shutdown of the Ring Rolling line including isolation, safe energy control, and cooldown handover to maintenance.

Preconditions
2. Production stop completed and no live billets in feed conveyors.  
3. Maintenance work order and access permit issued referencing ECN-2026-012 and ECN-2026-050.  
4. Confirm MM-P2-L2-HT02 has acknowledged heat treat furnace status.

Required PPE
5. Personnel must wear PPE per plant standard: hard hat, safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, and flame-resistant jacket.

Shutdown sequence
6. Isolate main power to EQ-P2-L2-IH01 and EQ-P2-L2-RR03 at the designated lockout points. Apply individual locks and tags.  
7. Place EQ-P2-L2-HT02 in Hold mode using control panel interlock. Verify control panel indicates Hold before proceeding.  
8. Drain and secure hydraulic accumulators on EQ-P2-L2-RR03 following manufacturer procedure.  
9. Verify all motion has stopped and confirm zero-energy state with multi-party verification. Record verifier names on the permit.  
10. Remove lubricants only when components are cool to touch. For EQ-P2-L2-HT02 replacement or service use lubricant part number for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is CFW-LUB-376.  
11. Do not perform furnace hearth entry until thermal confirmation is obtained. The austenitizing setpoint for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 855 °C. Confirm control readback is below acceptable threshold per MM-P2-L2-HT02 before entry.

Isolation verification
12. Perform verification checklist and sign each item. Include verification of mechanical blocks and tagout status.

Handover to Maintenance
13. Complete handover form, attach permit, and route to maintenance lead. Cite ECN-2026-012 and ECN-2026-050 in the handover.

Sign-off
14. Operations lead sign-off: name, signature, and date.  
15. Maintenance lead sign-off: name, signature, and date.  
16. Safety officer sign-off: name, signature, and date.
